test_inputs.explanation: product_id '2800' was taken from the admin edit URLs (several steps show /edit/id/2800/). The agent repeatedly visited the inventory tab (URLs contain back/edit/tab/product_info_tabs_inventory/), so inventory values (qty, manage_stock, is_in_stock) are provided. The 'back/edit' pattern indicates the agent used Save and Continue Edit, so save_action is set to 'save_and_continue'. Name, SKU, weight and price are reasonable concrete values to allow replaying the edit, website_ids uses the default site id '1', categories left empty to avoid toggling category checkboxes, and do_duplicate/do_delete are false since no duplicate/delete actions are shown. wait_seconds set to 2 as a short UI render wait.
